name: AverageOutput
description: Running mean of audio or control rate input since the last received trigger. The trigger resets both the average and the internal sample count to zero. From sc3-plugins RFWUGens.

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Reset trigger — clears the running average on transition from <= 0 to > 0

name: SwitchDelay
description: Feedback delay line that uses the switch-and-ramp technique (Miller Puckette, 'Theory and Techniques of Electronic Music') to neutralise click artefacts when moving the buffer read pointer. Useful for runtime delay-time changes without zipper noise. Feedback is internally limited slightly below 1.0 for safety. From sc3-plugins RFWUGens.

inputs.name: drylevel
inputs.description: Level of the dry input in the output mix

inputs.name: wetlevel
inputs.description: Level of the delayed signal in the output mix

inputs.name: delaytime
inputs.description: Delay time in seconds — can be modulated, switch-and-ramp masks the artefacts

inputs.name: delayfactor
inputs.description: Feedback multiplier (0..~1). Higher values lengthen the feedback tail; clamped below 1.0 to avoid runaway

inputs.name: maxdelaytime
inputs.description: Maximum delay buffer size in seconds (sets memory allocation, non-modulatable)
